title: Grab Bar 60-Inch Extended 3-Post ADA Compliant | Satin Nickel | Pipeline Grab Bars | Allied Brass | Bathroom Safety Bar Support Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable support in the bathroom with a wall-mounted grab bar (also called a safety bar or support bar) in an extended 60-inch length—ideal for accessible layouts and everyday confidence in Satin Nickel, which offers a warm, brushed finish that hides water spots and fingerprints, perfect for high-use bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Satin Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Match coordinating pieces from the Pipeline grab bars collection for a cohesive look
- Works well with transitional bathroom hardware for a balanced, versatile style
- Choose the look you want with multiple designer finish options available for versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Grab bar / bathroom grab bar / safety bar (wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging)
- Design: Extended 3-post with center support bracket
- Compliance: ADA Compliant
- Dimensions (overall): 63 in. (L) x 3 in. (H) x 3.58 in. (W)
- Box dimensions: 64 in. x 6 in. x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 6 lbs
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
